title: View the first lines of a file
summary: Use the `head` command to quickly see the beginning of a text file without opening it in an editor. This is useful for checking file contents, headers, or logs.

steps.explain: Display the first few lines of a specified file. By default, `head` shows 10 lines, but you can specify a different count with `-n`.

placeholders.name: COUNT
placeholders.description: Number of lines to display from the beginning of the file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file you want to view.

steps.expect: The terminal prints the first <COUNT> lines of the file.
